name: Ricardo Sepúlveda
bio:
Ricardo Sepúlveda's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for rally racing in the Atacama Desert. He started as a junior mechanic, quickly demonstrating a keen aptitude for understanding vehicle dynamics and a relentless drive for improvement. Ricardo honed his skills working across various racing disciplines, from touring cars to open-wheel racing, before transitioning into team management.

As a team principal, Ricardo is known for his meticulous planning and data-driven decision-making. He fosters a collaborative environment, empowering his team members to contribute their expertise while maintaining a strong focus on achieving strategic goals. His ability to blend technical knowledge with management acumen makes him a valuable asset to any motorsport organization.

Ricardo is distinguished by his ability to identify and nurture young talent, creating opportunities for aspiring engineers and drivers to excel. He's a firm believer in continuous learning and innovation, always seeking new ways to improve performance and gain a competitive edge.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: A man of medium build, Ricardo has a focused gaze and a perpetually thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas.
Has a habit of tapping his pen while deep in thought.
Insists on personally reviewing all telemetry data after each session.
